MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

2. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 40
   C. 41
   D. 3

3. Solve for x: x + 9 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 18

4. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

7. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

9. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 8
   C. 32
   D. 9

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 122

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

13. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 11

14. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

15. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

16. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

17. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 22
   C. 55
   D. 16

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

20. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 36

21. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

22. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 29

23. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

24. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

25. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 0
   C. 64
   D. 16

26. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

27. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 36

28. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

29. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 49
   C. 41
   D. 31

30. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
